name: Geijutsu Bunka Bu - Gaiden: Utakata Jinja
original_name: 芸術文化部 外伝 泡沫神社
source:
Modern Japan. Umekata High School exists in Umekata-gafuchi, a desolate rural area surrounded by mountains on all sides.
As the season approaches late summer with no end to the rainy season, the members of the 'Arts and Culture Club' - a.k.a. 'Geibun' - a group of eccentrics and oddballs, are playing games in the hot and humid club room today.
The main character 'Tsuuriwatsu', who transferred to Ume High after the summer holidays, meets the Arts and Culture Club, and while being pushed around by the free-spirited members, gradually deepens his friendship with them.
In the midst of these peaceful May days, Hachi wakes up in the classroom with the rain continuing to fall as usual today.
He rubs his sleepy eyes and, for some reason, there are traces of tears on his cheeks.
translation:
现代日本。梅方高中坐落于四面环山的荒凉乡村梅方渊。
夏末已至，雨季还未结束，“艺术文化俱乐部”（又名“艺文”）的成员们今天在炎热潮湿的俱乐部房间里玩游戏。
暑假结束后转学到梅高中的主人公“Tsuuriwatsu”与艺术文化部相遇，在自由奔放的成员们的摆布下，与他们的友谊逐渐加深。
在这宁静的五月里，八公在教室里醒来，今天和往常一样，雨还在下。
他揉了揉惺忪的睡眼，脸颊上不知为何有了泪痕。
